column1: # s1c.tsv -- the mutations base#1463 (config-gen S1c, the go.mod scanner of
# the pin registry and its Go oracle) requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh
# to report PINNED. One row per behaviour:
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.
# reader-marker-target-guard, as committed with base#1463, was the same
# mutation against the same spec as read-gomod-target; the runner refuses
# a duplicate row, so it is kept once, as read-gomod-target.

column5: if (0 && cr && b != 10) { print ln; exit }

column4: if [[ "${_gm_kind[_k]}" == p ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" punctuation; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == replace ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" replace; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == tool ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" tool; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == ignore ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" ignore; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == godebug ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" godebug; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == exclude ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" exclude; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_verb}" == retract ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" retract; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_gm_kind[1]}" == w && "${_gm_text[1]}" == *[\\"\\']* ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" module_quote; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_gm_kind[_k]}" == p && "${_gm_text[_k]}" == ')' ]]; then _pin_go_mod_refuse "${_ln}" paren_not_alone; return 1; fi
if [[ "${_last}" == *.* || "${_last}" == v0* || "${_last}" == v1 ]]; then _PIN_GO_MOD_REASON=path_major_invalid; return 1; fi
